shieldwall.name: Shield Wall
shieldwall.description: Until your next turn: +20 defense and +15 ranged defense, attacks from the sides count as frontal, and adjacent allies gain +6 defense.

shieldbash.name: Shield Bash
shieldbash.description: Slam an adjacent enemy for light damage, shaking its morale and pushing it back one tile. Blocked pushes deal extra damage.

spearwall.name: Spearwall
spearwall.description: Until your next turn: the first enemy to step into a tile in front of or beside this spearman takes a free attack at +15% hit and +50% damage. A hit stops its advance.

pikethrust.name: Pike Thrust
pikethrust.description: Strike an enemy two tiles away in a straight line, over the head of whoever stands between.

overwatch.name: Overwatch
overwatch.description: Hold fire. During the enemy turn, shoot the first enemy that moves within range and sight (-5% hit).

heavybolt.name: Heavy Bolt
heavybolt.description: A fully cranked bolt: +50% damage, ignores armour, costs two bolts.

charge.name: Brutal Charge
charge.description: Passive. After moving 2+ tiles, melee attacks deal +3 damage and cost the target 8 more morale.

warcry.name: War Cry
warcry.description: Allies within 4 tiles gain 20 morale; enemies within 4 tiles lose 8.

chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
chain_lightning.description: Lightning strikes an enemy squad in sight within 6 tiles for 9–12 per mage, ignoring armour, then arcs to the nearest other enemy within 2 tiles, and on to a third (60% and 36% of the damage).

frost_blast.name: Frost Blast
frost_blast.description: A blast of ice at an enemy squad within 5 tiles: 5–7 per mage, half that to enemies beside it. Everyone struck is chilled through their next turn: half movement, −10 to hit and −10 defense.

healing_light.name: Healing Light
healing_light.description: Heal a friendly squad (or the mages themselves) within 5 tiles for 8–11 per mage and steady them (+8 morale). Wounds close; the fallen stay dead.

mending_circle.name: Mending Circle
mending_circle.description: Every friendly squad within 2 tiles of the mages, themselves included, heals 4–6 per mage and gains 5 morale. The fallen stay dead.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: A ball of fire hurled at a tile within 6 tiles: 7–10 per shaman to the squad there and half to every squad beside it, friend or foe. A miss bursts one tile astray.

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.description: Drive a friendly squad within 4 tiles into a killing frenzy until the end of its next turn: +10 to hit and +3 damage per soldier in melee, morale losses halved, but −8 defense.

gutripper.name: Gutripper
gutripper.description: A hex that tears at the insides of an enemy squad within 5 tiles: 5–7 per shaman, ignoring armour, and the squad bleeds for 40% of that again at the start of each of its next two turns.

hurl_stone.name: Hurl Stone
hurl_stone.description: Lob a stone over walls and heads at a tile 3–9 tiles away: 10–14 per crewman to the squad there and 40% of that to every squad beside it, friend or foe. A miss lands one tile astray. Not in a turn the mangonel has moved.

lob_rock.name: Lob Rock
lob_rock.description: Lob a boulder at a tile 3–8 tiles away: 11–16 per crewman there and half beside it, friend or foe. Often lands a tile astray. Not in a turn it has moved.

shield_charge.name: Charge
shield_charge.description: Run at least 2 tiles and crash into an enemy behind the shields: +30% damage, +5% to hit and 10 more morale lost. A spear square breaks the charge.

defend.name: Defend
defend.description: Until your next turn: stand guard over every friendly squad beside this one. The first attack or shot aimed at one of them strikes the guard instead, always on its front. Free attacks, spells and squads that stand guard themselves are not covered.

square.name: Square
square.description: Until your next turn: spears out on every side. Every attack counts as frontal, the spears strike first at anyone who closes in from any side, charges lose their bonus and the square cannot be pushed. +6 defense, but −10 ranged defense: a packed target.

growl.name: Growl
growl.description: A low growl from the whole pack: enemies within 2 tiles lose 12 morale and are cowed until the end of their next turn (−10 to hit).

howl.name: Howl
howl.description: Promotion: the veterans' growl becomes a howl that carries. Enemies within 3 tiles lose 16 morale and are cowed until the end of their second turn (−10 to hit).

hound_charge.name: Charge
hound_charge.description: Bound at least 2 tiles and hit an enemy at full tilt: +20% damage, +12% to hit and 14 more morale lost. A spear square breaks the charge.

lick_wounds.name: Lick Wounds
lick_wounds.description: The hounds tend each other's wounds: heal 3–5 per hound standing, stop bleeding, shake off the chill and gain 6 morale. Not with an enemy beside them. The fallen stay dead.

aimed_shot.name: Aimed Shot
aimed_shot.description: Take the time to aim: +20% to hit, ignoring cover, an obstructed view and troops in the way, and 6 more morale lost. Only in a turn the crossbowmen have not moved.
